analysis:
This batch contains documentation and a changelog only. No Swift source was supplied. It documents a new selected-model recovery feature (ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift).

Files examined:
- changelog.d/selected-models-recover.md:1-8.
- docs/architecture/addon-hold.md head 64-69: an add-on hold invariant now adds that recovery is refused while held and that enterAddonHold cancels an in-flight recovery load.
- docs/architecture/hardware-support.md head 371-408: recovery uses allowEviction:false and pre-unloads only non-selected, non-excluded models. It honors evictionExclusions, pins, holds, leases, min_dwell and idle thresholds. Victims are evicted before the load's own checks, so a failed load costs one attempt's evictions.

Relevant threats:
- TB-012/T-059/A-018 (add-on hold: models must not load beside running VMs). The docs claim recovery is deferred while held and that a hold beginning mid-retry cancels the load. This preserves the T-059 invariant if the implementation matches. The race between the hold's settle/unload and a recovery load already past its hold check is the key integration question. Verify the enterAddonHold cancellation, the recovery's hold recheck before allocation, and that restoreAddonHolds closes admission before the recovery tick can run at startup.
- TB-007/T-029 (resource availability) and the load gate: recovery reuses the pending-load claim and load gate. That needs to be verified in source.
- Changelog line 8 describes a policy, still pending owner review, of releasing adopted non-selected models that are serving requests. This affects A-018 routing availability. It is not a confidentiality issue, but in-flight requests must finish and new ones must be refused cleanly.
- Shutdown now waits at most 15 s per model unload (changelog line 7). Integration should confirm that exiting with a native retirement still pending does not skip key or plaintext cleanup or KV/SSD donation teardown (T-028/T-041), and that the drain with the coordinator disconnected doesn't drop accepted work unsafely.

No concrete regression is evidenced from docs alone; the implementation was not supplied.
